en: The postcard features an early 20th-century colored photograph of seaside bathhouses on stilts in Varna, Bulgaria, with a wooden structure extending out into the sea and labeled for men's and women's sea baths. The handwritten text and postal details are in Bulgarian Cyrillic script. The reverse includes handwritten correspondence and postmarks from Varna dated 1910, as well as printed information about the publisher.
